name: Boot Loaders
author: brunonlinespace
description: Read-only structured inspection of installed/reported boot loaders, EFI System Partitions and EFI boot state with optional ephemeral privileged visibility.

capabilities.label: Boot-loader / EFI status
capabilities.standard: Uses bootctl status with ordinary-user access and structures the sections visible to the current user.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only bootctl status query through the verified helper, which can expose records or fields restricted by ordinary permissions.
